subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Showing how data is collected helps people understand why it can be trusted.”?
options: Good testing measures learning without ignoring dignity.
Sometimes an object becomes important because of the feelings people leave there.
It can hold the memory of what a place once believed about itself.
Transparency can be as important as testing itself.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Good testing measures learning without ignoring dignity.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes an object becomes important because of the feelings people leave there.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It can hold the memory of what a place once believed about itself.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Showing how data is collected helps people understand why it can be trusted. Transparency can be as important as testing itself.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Showing how data is collected helps people understand why it can be trusted. Transparency can be as important as testing itself.」，答案為「Transparency can be as important as testing itself.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Transparency can be as important as testing itself.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
